title: Keep-ish Inventory
description: A highly configurable keeping inventory alternative
body: Keep-ish Inventory adds a configurable keeping inventory alternative to the game, When you die your enchanted tools and armor will have a lower chance of dropping all the way up to 100% chance of being kept on you, The server config will be used to categorise items with their keep percentage chance based upon the config, All other items use the Item Rarity provided by minecraft with their percentages being configurable.
